description: Insufficient-data failure scenario: fewer closes than period+1 must return an error. Three sub-cases: (1) empty input with period=14, (2) exactly period closes (len=14, need 15), (3) period=0 invalid period. All must return an error — no RSI values produced.

expectedOutput.error: ErrInsufficientData or ErrInvalidPeriod depending on case
expectedOutput.note: All three cases MUST return a non-nil error. The rsi output MUST be nil/empty. No partial results are acceptable.
